source: NCERT-aligned UPSC Ecology & Environment (Class XI), Ch. 8 (International Environmental Conventions and Organisations).

sections.heading: 1. Milestone Conferences
points: **Stockholm Conference (1972)** — first UN Conference on the Human Environment; led to **UNEP** and World Environment Day (5 June).
**Rio Earth Summit (1992)** — gave **Agenda 21**, and the conventions on **climate (UNFCCC), biodiversity (CBD), and desertification (UNCCD)**.
**Rio+20 (2012)** and the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs, 2015 — 17 goals)**.

sections.heading: 2. Major Conventions — Biodiversity & Trade
points: **Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD, 1992)** — conserve biodiversity, sustainable use, fair benefit sharing; protocols: **Cartagena (biosafety)** and **Nagoya (access & benefit sharing)**.
**CITES (1973)** — regulates international **trade in endangered species** (of wild fauna and flora).
**Ramsar (1971)** — wetlands; **Bonn Convention (CMS)** — migratory species.

sections.heading: 3. Chemicals, Waste and Ozone Conventions
points: **Basel Convention (1989)** — controls transboundary movement of **hazardous wastes**.
**Rotterdam Convention** — trade in hazardous chemicals (prior informed consent).
**Stockholm Convention (2001)** — **Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs)**.
**Vienna Convention (1985)** and **Montreal Protocol (1987)** — protect the **ozone layer**.

sections.heading: 4. Key Organisations
points: **UNEP** (UN Environment Programme, HQ Nairobi); **IUCN** (Red List); **WWF**; **IPCC** (climate); **GEF** (Global Environment Facility — funding).
**IPBES** — biodiversity and ecosystem services science-policy body.
These bodies research, fund and coordinate global environmental action.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Stockholm 1972 → UNEP; Rio 1992 → Agenda 21 + UNFCCC + CBD + UNCCD.
CBD (1992): Cartagena (biosafety) + Nagoya (benefit sharing) protocols.
CITES (1973) = trade in endangered species; Ramsar (1971) = wetlands.
Basel (hazardous waste); Rotterdam (chemicals); Stockholm 2001 (POPs).
Montreal Protocol (1987) = ozone; SDGs (2015) = 17 goals.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **CITES (1973) = trade in endangered species**; **CBD (1992) = biodiversity conservation** (do not confuse).
**Basel = hazardous waste**; **Stockholm Convention (2001) = POPs**.
**Stockholm CONFERENCE (1972)** ≠ **Stockholm CONVENTION (2001, POPs)**.
**Nagoya Protocol = access and benefit sharing** (under the CBD).
